title: ProductCarousel
description: Renders an ordered list of commerce products for a single category or intent bucket. Read-only from the frontend: the backend is the sole source of truth for which products are displayed and in what order.

ProductListState.title: ProductListState
ProductListState.description: The ordered list of products to render. Owned exclusively by the backend; the frontend must not mutate this directly.
ProductListState.$comment: This schema validates the runtime state value the backend pushes to the frontend.

products.description: Ordered list of products to render.
